reviewSamples.text: Max was awesome! Remove my old Exhaust range hood and replaced it with my new low profile microwave. He had to cut out part of my cabinet and cabinet doors had to be cut. He was very professional, reasonably priced and quickly took care of the job. I definitely recommend him for your handyman services.
